findings: Receipt SHA-256 60e9d83a46a06c65b28067c141b06d8bfdb9ba5009fbfbcdb1dce37afe2f2fa3, fingerprint 040fc9e34487c4a2e878657ae72c15473afe2dd448048a224caa871069526175, all 22 recorded provenance inputs, the four implementation file hashes and implementation digest 38f6f21cebed80a3f46396f18b6c32aff1c5c2b15b239c6e1db72210788b654c recompute exactly.

All four physical adapter_model.safetensors checkpoints were reopened directly. Each contains the matched layer-0 gate_proj LoRA A and B tensors as finite float32 arrays with shapes [8, 1024] and [3584, 8]. All eight A/B SHA-256 values reproduce the retained target ledger. Fresh CPU B@A multiplication produces finite [3584, 1024] deltas whose four SHA-256 values exactly reproduce 66248f73279d764c707bcc4a0e0d77df4b568f75676e833d989bee27d4155e63, 367c1caa5dce503c7c235cd9540166f573a92bea945d5b2ceea64a1ab10a1120, c6ce16b624b460a07e9ff770dccb43defe2e121c5c5039724e2538d71b954eee and bd95891796a40796969cc20c65ec4fa63deb7434e2a5c530ca8bf01467f7f8a2.

Target distinctness is material rather than a hash-only distinction. Pairwise cosine among the four physical deltas ranges from 0.0005582744 to 0.0320755839, pairwise L2 distance ranges from 0.1549686 to 0.1593233, and no pair is tensor-equal. The physical_targets and target_distinctness passes are independently confirmed.

The frozen generator architecture has exactly 16,640 parameters in Linear(64,256), 131,584 in Linear(256,512), and 18,911,232 in Linear(512,36,864), totaling 19,059,456 parameters. Exact FP32 parameter storage is 76,237,824 bytes or 72.7060546875 MiB, so the <=20 MiB overhead gate fails decisively. FP16/BF16 would still occupy 36.35302734375 MiB. This is not a telemetry or unit-tolerance false negative; the result labels the MiB value as MB, but either binary or decimal units remain far above 20.

The four retained cosine scalars reaggregate to mean 0.9998621344566345 with range 0.9997837543487549 to 0.9999080896377563, exactly matching the receipt. However, the trained generator state and generated A/B or B@A tensors were not retained, so none of the four physical cosines can be independently recomputed. These receipt-bound scalars are compatible with strong memorization fidelity but are not independently verified positive evidence.

The independent_recompute gate is a semantic false positive. The host runner only recomputes the arithmetic mean of the same four cosine scalars emitted by the worker and compares it with the worker's mean. It does not recompute any cosine from generated and physical tensors, despite the preregistered independent-recompute wording.

The latency pass is not independently auditable. The worker discards all 400 CUDA-event observations and retains only the scalar median 0.09932799637317657 ms; worker.json itself is not among the receipt provenance inputs. Moreover, the timed region covers only network(code), excluding B@A materialization, adapter application, transfers and serving integration. The scalar may describe isolated synthesis-forward latency, but cannot support end-to-end, runtime or production claims.

The trained network has 129.25 times as many FP32 parameters as directly retaining the four evaluated A/B targets, which require only 147,456 float32 values or 0.5625 MiB. The final 512-to-36,864 layer accounts for 99.2223 percent of generator parameters. Therefore the four-target fidelity indication is a memorization screen, not evidence of compression or unseen-task generalization.

The original acceptance rule is a conjunction and the exact FP32 resource gate is false. HYPER01_NEGATIVE_RETAINED_R1 is therefore independently supported as a bounded rejection of this architecture under the frozen <=20 MiB contract even though the positive fidelity and latency gates remain unverified. This does not broadly falsify hypernetworks or prove that the original random-target fidelity rejection was correct.

A distinct compressed-GPU successor is scientifically admissible, but cannot rescue this packet post hoc. Raw INT8 weights would nominally occupy 18.176513671875 MiB and raw INT4 weights 9.0882568359375 MiB; a successor must preregister its quantizer, retain the serialized generator including scales, retain generated tensors and all raw timing observations, measure actual GPU allocation, and compare against direct target storage before claiming compression.

Claim limit: this review supports only HYPER01_NEGATIVE_RETAINED_R1 for one matched layer-0 gate_proj module, four training targets and the frozen FP32 conjunction. It does not support whole-adapter generation, held-out-task generalization, compressed execution, end-to-end latency or production adapter synthesis.
